newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - America Online shrs fall.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - America Online shrs fall.

text.p: Shares of America Online Inc fell in moderate volume after hours, traders said, with the stock falling 3/4 to 24.
After the market closed, the company posted a first-quarter loss of $3.80 per share compared with a loss of $0.14 per share in the year-earlier period.

The current quarter included a write-off of $385.2 million in deferred subscriber acquisition costs. Excluding the write-off, the company posted a first-quarter profit of $0.17 per share. Excluding a charge, earnings were $0.06 per share in the previous first quarter.
Revenues soared to $349.9 million compared to $197.9 million last year, the company said.
America Online's stock fell 1/2 to 24-3/4 during regular market hours.

The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 3,500 shares compared to 86,300 shares on Wednesday. Session two volume was 1,789,100 shares compared to Wednesday's volume of 475,681 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
